text:
alex: Heads-up — marketing needs the final changelog and docs links for tomorrow's announce. Can engineering confirm the canary window and the demo slot?

maria: We can do canary 2026-03-22 09:00-10:00 PT, demo at 11:00 PT, full rollout after the webinar (approx 14:00 PT). Need sign-off on the blog one-liner by 16:00 PT today. :calendar:

ben: changelog draft is in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — small entries, one breaking note re: quantization flags.

casey: I'll drop docs links into the release notes once PR merges. Current staging doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-2026-03-22 — will update anchors for new endpoints.

lina: Bench narrative ready but want to confirm metrics to include. Proposed: p50 latency 35ms, p95 120ms, cost per 1k tokens down 18% vs baseline. Do we have an approved prompt set?

alex: @lina include the eval set we ran last week (eval-set-A). Also include a short note about batching/kv cache settings used.

ben: note in PR header with sample changelog entry:

```
- perf: quantize float16->8 with new kernel; reduces memory and cut per-token cost ~18% (see bench)
- docs: add /v1/streaming and /v1/embeddings links
```

casey: docs link I'll publish to staging by EOD: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-22 (won't be live until after merge). Can marketing use the staging URL for preview?

maria: Yes, marketing will use staging for preview only. We need the final public URL 30 mins before the announce for social + support playbook.

alex: Deploy/runbook questions — is the canary fully automated? rollback policy?

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: canary-deploy-2026-03-22-09 -> target pool: dedicated-gpu-pool-3. Auto-rollback: enabled (fail rate >2% in first 10m).

ben: Canary is automated. We'll monitor error budget and latency. Manual rollback plan documented in the runbook (link in PR).

maria: Webinar logistics: host (maria), engineering lead (alex), bench walkthrough (lina). Can we confirm a 25-min demo + 15-min Q&A?

alex: yes 25/15 works. Lina — can you prep 3 slides: 1) perf highlights, 2) demo config (batching/kv cache), 3) guidance for customers (when to pick dedicated vs hosted)?

lina: on it. I'll post slide draft to the drive and ping here when ready.

casey: support playbook: need a one-paragraph FAQ and a short rollback troubleshooting checklist. I'll draft from the runbook.

maria: marketing needs: 1) Tweet-length one-liner, 2) 3 bullet talking points for blog hero, 3) 2 customer-facing bench callouts. Due by 16:00 PT.

alex: Final checklist from eng: PR merged, docs URL updated, canary scheduled (deploy-bot confirmed), bench numbers approved by @lina, slide deck ready. If all green, marketing can publish at 11:00 PT.

ben: merging PR once tests pass. ETA ~13:30 PT today.

casey: I'll have docs staging link up by 15:30 PT.

lina: bench numbers locked and posted to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/2026-03-22 — review welcome.

maria: Perfect — if anything slips, please ping me asap here. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team. tagging this thread for final wrap at 16:30 PT and quick sign-off.

maria: Roger that.
